fields.text: Attention please. HWK Air flight six six six to Purgatory is now boarding at all gates. All passengers for flight six six six, please proceed to your gate immediately.
fields.voiceDirection: Calm synthetic female paging voice, even pace, slight hall reverb
fields.terminalAmbience: Busy terminal atrium: rolling bags, crowd murmur, distant gate announcements
fields.deliveryNote: Play the audio on the room speakers while the FIDS board image (I-06) is on the main screen. Do not explain it.
